question: An infinite number of point charges are placed on the x-axis. Charges of $+q$ are located at $x = a, 3a, 5a, ...$ and charges of $-q$ are located at $x = -a, -3a, -5a, ...$ up to infinity. What is the magnitude of the net electrostatic force on a point charge $+Q$ placed at the origin ($x=0$)? (Given the series sum: $1 + 1/3² + 1/5² + ... = π²/8$)
